{#- Header language switcher: a compact native
/ dropdown. The closed state shows only the current language code (a small fixed footprint that cannot overflow the header at any viewport width); opening reveals every language with the current one marked, in an absolutely-positioned panel that overlays content instead of stretching the header. Dependency-free and licence-clean: native HTML disclosure, no required script, no external asset; styling lives with the header family in _static/cadrumo-docs.css using Furo's CSS variables so light and dark both render (cadrumo-docs.js adds optional outside-click / Escape dismissal as progressive enhancement). The per-page hrefs are the same relative computation as before (page path to its language root); the language set, current language, and default flag come from docs/conf.py html_context. -#} {%- if cadrumo_docs_languages -%} {#- Relative path from this page to its current language root (e.g. '../' or ''). -#} {%- set _root = pathto(master_doc) -%} {%- if '/' in _root -%}{%- set _root_uri = _root.rsplit('/', 1)[0] ~ '/' -%}{%- else -%}{%- set _root_uri = '' -%}{%- endif -%} {#- The shared base holding every language root: the current root for the default (en, served at the base) build, one level up for a localized subdir build. -#} {%- set _docs_base = _root_uri if cadrumo_docs_language_is_default else _root_uri ~ '../' -%} {%- set _current = (cadrumo_docs_languages | selectattr('code', 'equalto', cadrumo_docs_language) | list | first) -%}
{{ cadrumo_docs_language | upper }}
